Record a lifecycle event (end of support, end of life, …) for a version or the whole project

Usage: hpy registry plugin lifecycle [OPTIONS] [VERSION] [EVENT]

Arguments:
  [VERSION]  The version the event is about; with --project, the event itself
  [EVENT]    endOfDevelopment, endOfSupport, supersededBy, endOfDistribution or endOfLife

Options:
      --json                     Print the result as JSON on stdout
      --project                  The event is about the whole project rather than one version
      --kind <KIND>              What kind of event it is, in your own words (e.g. security)
      --no-input                 Never prompt; fail when a value is missing. Irreversible actions
                                 still need --yes. Implied without a terminal
  -C <DIR>                       Run as if started in DIR
      --reason <REASON>          Why, for the people running it
      --superseded-by <VERSION>  The version to move to (with supersededBy)
      --withdraw <STATUS_URI>    Withdraw a status recorded in error, by its at:// URI
      --name <NAME>              Project name (default: hpy.toml [project] name, then manifest.json
                                 id)
  -y, --yes                      Do not ask for confirmation
  -h, --help                     Print help
